versions.content: function  Dem_SetEventAvailable  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00005]   Std_ReturnType Dem_SetEventAvailable(Dem_EventIdType EventId, boolean AvailableStatus); Enables or suppresses the availability of a diagnostic event depending on variant coding and hardware configuration. Diagnostic Communication Manager (DCM) The DCM implements unified diagnostic services according to ISO 14229-1 (UDS) and ISO 15765-4 (OBD). It manages diagnostic sessions, security levels, and service routing.
